@ClassVersion(sourceVersion="$Id: PerfLogClientBase.java 1216 2026-05-02 11:16:24Z tquadrat $") @API(status=INTERNAL, since="0.25.0") private static record PerfLogClientBase.Janitor(NotificationEmitter mbean, PerfLogClientBase.PerfLogNotificationListener listener) extends Record implements Runnable

The janitor that takes care of the housekeeping for an instance of PerfLogClientBase in case that was not properly closed.
